'''JCLD Galactic Shipping''' was a business that was active on the [[planet]] [[Coruscant]] a few [[Standard year|years]] after the formation of the [[New Republic]]. It was located in a [[skyscraper]] situated next to [[Monument Plaza]]. A vertical sign stated the name of the company in [[Aurebesh]].<ref name="Chapter 19" />
